witcher-world.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — official gallery screenshot
witcher-world.sourceDate: Retrieved 7 October 2026; individual capture date and game build not supplied
witcher-world.basis: One official gallery image, used for specific criticism and comparison. CDPR’s fan guidelines condition permission on non-commercial use, unofficial identification and no incorporation into other products. This mixed analysis and author-project context relies on a bounded criticism/review assessment rather than claiming blanket fan-policy clearance.
witcher-world.purpose: A monster encounter within a traversable landscape introduces the relation between placed encounters, authored quests and a world the player explores.
witcher-world.treatment: Complete frame retained; no repainting, cropping, recoloring or removal of marks. Responsive WebP versions at 400, 800 and up to 1440 pixels. Analytical highlights, where present, are separate interface overlays. No game files, extracted models, music or downloadable art collection.
